models.name: Random Forest Regressor
models.notes: Best overall performer. Superior non-linear ensemble splits robust to right-skewed prices. Powers the live appraisal engine.

models.name: Decision Tree Regressor
models.notes: Strong standalone tree with depth bounding (max_depth=10) preventing runaway leaf overfitting.

models.name: SVR (RBF, X+y scaled)
models.scaling: StandardScaler on BOTH X and y
models.notes: Required target scaling on BOTH X and y; without y-scaling, SVR produces negative R² due to wide target range (₹40k to ₹3.95Cr).

models.name: Linear Regression
models.notes: Parametric baseline. Underperforms due to non-linear depreciation curves and power scaling.

models.name: AdaBoost Regressor
models.notes: Underperforms significantly. AdaBoost's loss function is acutely sensitive to extreme target outliers (luxury exotics > ₹1Cr and km > 3.8M km), repeatedly over-weighting outlier residuals.

feature_importances.label: Engine Power (bhp)
feature_importances.insight: Dominant predictor by a wide margin. Horsepower dictates vehicle luxury class, trim level, and original MSRP.

feature_importances.label: Fuel Mileage (km/l)
feature_importances.insight: Key split differentiator: high mileage (22-33 km/l) strongly isolates entry budget hatchbacks from heavy luxury cars (8-14 km/l).

feature_importances.label: Vehicle Age (years)
feature_importances.insight: Drives compounding annual depreciation decay curve (~8-12% value loss per year).

feature_importances.label: Odometer (km driven)
feature_importances.insight: Quantifies mechanical wear & tear, warranty expiry, and pending maintenance cycles.

feature_importances.label: Engine Displacement (cc)
feature_importances.insight: Correlates with chassis weight and engine cylinder count.

feature_importances.label: Make / Brand
feature_importances.insight: Differentiates luxury prestige marques from mass-market retainers.

feature_importances.label: Transmission (Automatic/Manual)
feature_importances.insight: Automatic transmissions retain consistent ₹50k-₹1.5L resale premiums.

feature_importances.label: Seating Capacity
feature_importances.insight: Separates 7-8 seater utility MPVs/SUVs from compact 4-5 seaters.

feature_importances.label: Fuel Type (Diesel/Petrol/CNG)
feature_importances.insight: Diesel vehicles previously commanded higher commercial value in India.

feature_importances.label: Seller Type
feature_importances.insight: Dealer and Trustmark channels price slightly higher than individual private sales.
